image_prompt.text: A raised central platform where fighters spawn, set back and elevated above the surrounding walkways so nobody appears inside an opponent's reach
Large anime-styled columns and standing structures spaced across the lobby floor, tall enough for a retreating fighter to break line of sight behind
A built-up ring of anime-aesthetic buildings enclosing the lobby — shopfronts, tiered rooftops and hanging signage packed shoulder to shoulder rather than scattered
Stairs and elevated walkways running from the central platform up to the raised ledges and rooftop terraces around the lobby
Decorative trees and street lamps dressing the lobby between the buildings
Solid boundary walls ringing the whole lobby and closing off the edge of the play space

layout_placement.text: Player spawns on the central platform, elevated and screened from the surrounding walkways so a fighter is not in an opponent's line the frame they appear

notes: would have asked: Sounds like a battlegrounds lobby — a bounded anime clash space with a raised central spawn platform, stairs up to elevated walkways, pillars and structures to break line of sight, a built-up ring of anime buildings around the edge, and boundary walls holding it all in. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: the elevated walkways — does any of it hang out over the floor below, like catwalks or balconies? I built them as terraces reached by stairs with nothing overhanging, because true overhangs need a different build that isn't ready yet; say the word and I'll note it for when it is.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?

Preset Battlegrounds taken with its shape swapped from arena-flat to arena-tiered, because the prompt asks for a central platform, stairs and elevated walkways — strong elevation, but nothing stated to overhang.
Dropped the preset's hazard-kill: boundary walls around the lobby are the opposite of open ring-out edges, so carrying it would have built pits into a walled hub.

'lobby' is also a Party & Casual recogniser, but nothing round-based, minigame-driven or portal-based is described — the prompt is a battlegrounds map for an anime fighting game, so Action leads alone.
Buildings are treated as facades. Nothing in the prompt says players go inside, so no interior pass was added; if the shops or halls are meant to be enterable that is a separate, slower build.

The prompt asks to expose colour attributes for the platform, buildings, walls and ground. That is a build-time parameterisation request the layout handoff has nowhere to carry, so it is recorded here.
The prompt refers to a reference image that was not supplied; the layout was derived from the text alone.
